## Traeger Announces Chief Financial Officer Transition


November 25, 2026


**Joey Hord to remain with Traeger through February 1, 2027 to support transition;** **Company reiterates full year fiscal 2026 guidance**


SALT LAKE CITY--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Traeger, Inc. ("Traeger" or the "Company") (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced that Joey Hord will step down as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective February 1, 2027, to pursue another opportunity outside of Traeger’s industry. Hord will remain in his role through that date to support an orderly transition.


"I am grateful for Joey’s leadership, partnership, and contributions during his five years with the Company," said Jeremy Andrus, Chief Executive Officer of Traeger. "On behalf of all of us at Traeger, I wish him well in his next chapter. We have a strong finance team in place, and our strategy and priorities are unchanged. We look forward to welcoming a new CFO as we continue to execute on our plan."


"It has been a privilege to be part of the Traegerhood for the past five years," said Hord. "I'm proud of what this team has built, and I'm confident in the Company's direction. I look forward to supporting a smooth transition over the coming months."


Hord’s decision is not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies, or practices, including its accounting principles, financial statement disclosures, or internal controls.


The Company has commenced a search for a new Chief Financial Officer with the assistance of an executive search firm and may appoint an interim Chief Financial Officer if a successor is not in place by February 1, 2027.


In addition, Traeger is reiterating its full year fiscal 2026 guidance, as previously provided on November 4, 2026.


**About Traeger**


Traeger, headquartered in Salt Lake City, is the creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, an outdoor cooking system that ignites all-natural hardwoods to grill, smoke, bake, roast, braise, and barbecue. In 2023, Traeger entered the griddle category, further establishing its leadership position in the outdoor cooking space. Traeger grills are versatile and easy to use, empowering cooks of all skill sets to create delicious meals with flavor that cannot be replicated. Grills are at the core of our platform and are complemented by Traeger wood pellets, rubs, sauces, accessories, and MEATER smart thermometers.
